- **Routes:** a fixed whitelist maps `/` and `/index.html` to `index.html` (`text/html; charset=utf-8`) and `/style.css` to `style.css` (`text/css; charset=utf-8`). Paths are never built from the URL, so traversal isn't possible.

  - Any other path or method returns 404.
  - A failed file read returns 500.
  - It listens on `process.env.PORT` or 3000 and logs the URL.
- **Files:** `<path>`. I didn't touch `index.html` or `style.css`.
